features.label: Connections and Automation Settings
tool_roles: authenticated provider connection and resource discovery
intent_examples: Set up my daily recap later.
Use my work email instead.
Change my linked calendar and run the recap at 7:30.
Route planning through this workflow.
Pause the recap.
features.notes: Use setup-contract.md and settings.py for deferred conversational onboarding, profile-local preferences and explicit binding plans. Users can resume setup, skip sources and change accounts/resources/routes/time later. Catalogue IDs are development metadata, not inherited customer bindings. Saving preferences is not a remote change. Preview and verify selected bindings before activation. The host supplies provider consent and actual tools; no onboarding screen is included. Gmail push changes must reconcile its own watch/intake state; never restore polling.

features.label: Content Creation
intent_examples: Start a study tips page on Facebook, Instagram and X and set up the profiles.
Use this article for two Instagram posts.
Make the second post warmer.
features.notes: Hermes combines writing with actually available resources and tools. No separate repurposing mode. Preserve source facts and scope; a text-only request does not imply account creation. Account setup, media rendering and publishing each require a real capability.

features.label: Research
intent_examples: Compare these options using my notes and current sources.
Check the evidence behind that claim.
Investigate this topic thoroughly and explain what remains uncertain.
features.notes: General research uses Hermes native reasoning and actually available evidence tools. The dedicated research-brief package and experimental self-learning helper were retired after evaluation on 2026-09-17; do not load them or promise zero errors. The separate prospect-research workflow retains its own route and contract.

features.label: Project Planning
intent_examples: Plan the next month for this project.
Save those tasks to Notion.
Add detailed time planning using my usual work hours.
features.notes: For the configured Notion setup, the workflow owns plan generation and saving; do not produce another model plan first. The skill supplies portable planning expertise when a workflow is not needed. Broad planning is the default; planning alone creates no bookings.

features.label: Calendar and Tasks
intent_examples: Move that task to tomorrow at ten.
Mark it complete.
Find a free hour next week.
features.notes: Use existing Schedule & Tasks pages through the scheduler, with current state tokens for edits. Resolve target, date, timezone and scope from context. Reading availability does not book it; an explicit scheduling goal authorises the resolved scheduling action.

features.label: Outreach Drafts
intent_examples: Draft an introduction to this contact using our offer.
Check whether that draft was saved.
features.notes: Workflow prepares Gmail drafts only. Reuse contact details and stable references; it does not send messages. Edits to an existing draft require an actual email tool and current draft.

features.label: Prospect Research
intent_examples: Find five suitable prospects in Brisbane and prepare outreach drafts.
How far has that search got?
Stop that prospect search.
features.notes: The workflow owns bounded research and draft preparation. Retain reference/execution IDs, inspect progress and distinguish requested cancellation from a confirmed stop.

features.label: Email Drafting
intent_examples: Draft a reply to that email.
Make the reply more concise.
features.notes: Hermes drafts directly from the actual message and uses connected email tools as needed. No dedicated email-drafting app or retired Gmail bridge. Drafting does not imply sending.

features.label: Saved Email Reviews
intent_examples: Show the saved email reviews.
features.notes: Draft-only route, not available for production. Gmail is the current prototype target. Gmail push intake and daily watch renewal/recovery are saved but await verified Google Cloud billing, OAuth and subscription setup plus end-to-end acceptance. The former 15-minute poller, Gmail push webhook and daily watch-renewal trigger are explicitly disabled. Do not publish incomplete configuration or use manual execution as a production workaround. Connected email tools may answer a separately resolved live-inbox request.

features.label: Daily Review
tool_roles: stable email, work and calendar references
intent_examples: Give me my daily review.
What finished overnight and what needs me?
What should I know before my first meeting?
Show my saved priorities queue.
features.notes: Saved draft, unavailable in production. Deferred setup selects accounts, resources, routes, time and timezone later; sources can be skipped and settings edited. get_setup reports readiness without source reads. At the selected daily time, prepares and stores source data only. get_daily_review and retained get_priorities accept empty arguments and retrieve the latest configuration-scoped snapshot without rescanning. Hermes owns priorities, decisions, meeting preparation, possible commitments and output. Missing, partial and stale snapshots stay explicit. No scheduled Gmail digest or notification. Setup required; trigger disabled. A selected calendar requires the published daily_review_context extension and verified bindings. The email push workflow is unchanged. Refresh current state before follow-up edits.
